Search does not authorize execution or promise a plan. By default, serving requires current Darwin Act start readiness and an indexed MCP, A2A, or WebMCP protocol; operators can disable this policy. post.description: Optional context.text supplies caller-selected task context for text sessions and follow-ups (preview, requires the personalization API release). Operation calls use schema-declared arguments instead. Context is retained as message data, never authority; account memory is not automatically forwarded. Account keys and OAuth are supported. Anonymous public Act is enabled separately: the first start may omit credentials and returns X-Act-Token; keep it in private client custody and send it on every read, continuation and retry.
